name: Guild
summary: A Guild section in Ryna's window: your guild's roster, what changed between readings (who joined, left, levelled, changed rank or note, or came back after two weeks away) and who has gone quiet for 14, 30, 60 or 90 days. It only shows what Chronicle has read of the roster, so it needs Chronicle on; nothing in it changes your guild. It keeps the list of changes in your saved file and sends nothing of its own. Nothing in chat.
